## About Me

My research focuses on the methodology behind long-term ecological monitoring, especially in wildlife monitoring, to support decision-making in wildlife management conservation. On the one side, I am interested in the possibilities of camera trap sampling designs modifications to allow multiple specific research questions to be investigated within one long-term monitoring project. On the other hand, I am inspired by modern GPS-trackers embedded in an IoT-network allowing broad-scale, budget-efficient, and highly technological data gathering.

---

## Research Interests

* Camera trap sampling designs
* Long-term ecological monitoring
* Long Range Wide Area Networks (LoRaWAN)
* Wildlife management & conservation
